sources.profile: Ada Byron. Senior Backend Engineer at Halcyon Systems, 2019 to 2025. Built the billing ingestion service in Python and PostgreSQL, moved it onto Kubernetes, and cut p95 latency by 38%. Before that, Backend Engineer at Ferrograph, 2017 to 2019. BSc Computing, Imperial College London. Skills: Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, gRPC.
sources.job_description: Northstar Labs is hiring a Platform Engineer for the payments group. You will own service reliability, work in Python against PostgreSQL, and run workloads on Kubernetes. We care about latency budgets and clean rollbacks.

cases.output:
Dear Hiring Team,

The Platform Engineer opening at Northstar Labs lines up with the six years I spent on payment infrastructure at Halcyon Systems. I owned the billing ingestion service there, wrote it in Python against PostgreSQL, and moved it onto Kubernetes without a rollback.

Latency budgets are the part of that work I liked most. Cutting p95 latency by 38% meant reading a lot of slow query plans and arguing for a smaller service boundary, and both of those are habits I would bring to the payments group.

Sincerely,
Ada Byron
